Commentary.Commentary: Earlier, Sam Curran's spell had India in all sorts of trouble. The youngster took out the cream of the touring team's batting and had them on the mat. Post that, Ben Stokes joined the party and removed Rahane and Karthik in quick time. Hardik Pandya spent some time in the middle with his skipper to raise a handy stand but he too fell soon. Virat Kohli kept on losing his partners but never lost his cool. He maintained his composure and stroked his maiden ton on English soil. The England bowlers turned completely flat towards the end as Kohli milked them for runs along with Ishant and Umesh. Let's see how much effect that will have on England's second innings.

Virat Kohli's masterclass has helped India from conceding a big lead. The skipper led from the front. He was dropped a couple of times and he made England pay dearly for it. An innings of grit and determination. The last two wickets added 92 runs and that brought the deficit down to just 13 runs. England will be hurting at the moment. The momentum is with India and they would like to take a few wickets before stumps today.

OUT! Absolutely against the run of play! Virat Kohli falls but he has not let India fall in this Test match. A brilliant 149 from him and England have managed just a 13-run lead. Rashid delivers a short ball outside off, Kohli camps back to play the square cut but ends up hitting it straight into the hands of Broad at backward point. He takes the catch and runs in joy towards the bowler. A standing ovation for the Indian skipper as he leaves the field. His wife Anushka Sharma is also applauding the effort of her man. Genius knock. India are all out for 274!

SIX! This has gone all the way. Virat moves to 149! Rashid slows this one up and serves it on the shorter side around middle. Kohli goes deep inside the crease and muscles it over long on for a biggie.
Drifting into the batsman, it lands full on middle as Kohli tries to whip it across the line. Fails to middle it properly and it goes off the inside edge to short fine leg.
Short this time, around off, Kohli stays back and cuts it to deep point. Again no run taken.
Advances down the track to a full ball and smashes it to long off. No run taken.
Extra flight this time, lands full and outside off, Kohli drives it firmly but finds the extra cover fielder.
Pitches it full and outside off, Yadav leans forward and pushes it to covers. Huge cheer from the crowd as Umesh plays out this over safely.
Solid as a rock! Umesh once again dead bats a length ball towards mid off.
Another delivery has been angled into the batsman, Umesh keeps his eyes on the ball and brings his bat down in time to block it.
Good length ball dropping outside off and shaping back in, Yadav remains back footed and keeps it out safely towards short mid-wicket.
A low full toss on off, hit from the toe end of the bat to mid off.
Full and angling into the batsman, Umesh leans across and plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
FOUR! 50-run stand comes up, deficit is under 20 now. A quicker one down the leg side, Virat kneels down and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
FOUR! The field came up for this delivery and Kohli makes full use of it. Receives the short ball from the crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Kohli tries to cut but misses.
Flighted and full outside off, hit through the line towards covers.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.

Flighted full ball on middle, Kohli advances down the track and whips it against the spin. Anderson runs across to his right from long on and puts in a dive to stop it from touching the fence. Parries it out towards Jennings who has come in from deep mid-wicket. He does the rest and Kohli's gets his desired outcome, a couple of runs.
Sharp delivery. Full and straight, Umesh does well to keep it out on the off side. Had he missed that, he would have been plumb in front.
Fractionally short and outside off, Kohli plays it with gentle hands towards cover-point and this time picks up a single. Stokes has one ball to bowl at Yadav.

That's a beauty from nowhere. Shows there is still some life in this pitch. A good length ball landing outside off, straightening a bit off the seam, Kohli pushes inside the line and misses. Stokes is frustrated.
Shortish and outside off, Kohli slaps it towards deep cover and turns down the single.
Full and angling in, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
FOUR! What a shot! Kohli continues to go great guns. Stokes delivers a length ball outside off, Virat is forward with a big stride and spanks it over covers for a boundary.
A wrong 'un, slower through the air and curling back in, Umesh picks it probably and defends it back to the bowler.
Nicely tossed up delivery, full and around off, Umesh lunges in defense.
Leans forward and pushes it with the spin through point. A single taken.
Virat has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
Loopy and full outside off, drilled down to long off, no run taken.
This one is wide outside off, Yadav sensibly lets it through to the keeper.
Bangs it in again, Kohli goes for the hook but the bounce gets big on him. Mistimes the shot but it goes in the gap at square leg. A single taken.
FOUR! Nails it! Short in length around middle, Kohli stands tall inside the crease and nails his pull shot through square leg. It's England vs Kohli at the moment. 250 up! Deficit is 36 only.
Shortish and angling down the leg side, Kohli mistimes his shot to square leg.
FOUR! Stylish! A good length ball outside off, Kohli keeps his weight on the back leg and plays a fluent inside-out shot over extra cover. The fielder chases it but the ball wins the race.
Hits the yorker mark, Kohli digs it out back to the bowler.
Full and flighted outside off, Yadav safely keeps it out. Deficit - 44 runs.
Switches to 'round the wicket and serves a full ball around leg, Kohli makes space and drives it down to long off for a single.
Shortish on off, pulled down to long on but once again no run taken.
Played through the point region by the batsman. Not taking any run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Kohli gets back and helps it to the leg side.
FOUR! Shot! Flighted full ball around off, Kohli goes with the spin and blazes it over extra cover. There is a long off in place but he has no chance of cutting it off.
Stokes continues to bang it in short, Kohli top edges his pull towards fine leg and keeps strike with a single.
Another shorter delivery, rising onto the batsman, Virat pulls but finds the fielder at square leg.
A predominantly on side field now. Stokes in full throttle here. Digs in a sharp short ball and Kohli mistimes his pull to deep square leg.
Yorker on middle, Kohli digs it out safely.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot again.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Four byes! A googly, turning down the leg side and beating everyone. Yadav fails to flick, Bairstow fails to collect and it races behind for a boundary.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Quicker and flatter around off, too close to cut but Kohli still goes for it. Gets a bottom edge as it goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Fullish and outside off, pushed out towards the off side.

Appeal for a stumping, referred upstairs. Rashid serves a flatter delivery, short and wide outside off, Kohli tries to cut by going deep inside the crease but misses. Bairstow collects the ball and removes the bails. For a moment, it appeared that the Indian skipper lost his balance and the square leg umpire also decides to go upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Virat was safely in. He lost his balance a bit but never left the crease.
A low full toss outside off, Kohli drives it to deep cover. No run taken.

Short again, Kohli pulls it albeit with not much control. He still manages to clear mid-wicket and takes a single. Umesh Yadav, for some reason, decides to take off for the second. It's the last ball of the over! Kohli rightly sends him back and he dives to get in. Comical, really. Even his captain is having a little laugh.
FOUR! Short and angling down, Kohli with a little swivel pulls it down to fine leg. The man in the deep moves to his right but can't get to it. Boundary. All vital runs for India.
Shouts for an lbw, but it's shut down! Impact outside off. Length delivery straightening up, Kohli looks to play at it but is caught on the pads.
Moves inside the line, uses the angle well and works it straight to mid-wicket.
Too far outside off, it's left alone.
Just ahead of a length on that off stump line, Kohli blocks it out.
Quicker, flatter and going down leg, catches Umesh on the thigh pad as he tries to flick it away.
Fifth ball of the over and this time Kohli decides to take a single. Eases it to long on and gets to the other end.
Defends this in front of covers for nothing.
Some air on this again, Kohli whips it to deep mid-wicket. Doesn't take the run obviously.
The leg break outside off, on a fullish length, Kohli attempts to drive it through the covers but misses.
Looped up outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
FOUR! Runs will come thick and fast now. A short ball has been smashed through mid-wicket. It speeds through but then loses some venom and just trickles past the rope.

FOUR! Here it is, the elusive century for Virat Kohli in England. A knock of determination. Not a chanceless one but he has shown tremendous character. England will be hurting. A short of a length ball outside off, Kohli strokes it square of the wicket and it speeds through backward point. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it with a dive but misses. Kohli has a big smile on his face. Removes the chain around his neck from under his shirt and kisses his engagement ring on it. Thanking his lady luck. Virat Kohli has conquered his final frontier. This was the only place where he had a dismal record. Every now and then the last tour was reminded to him. His average is shoddy, technique not up to the mark for these conditions. He has proved everyone wrong. One can argue that England gave him life twice but that's part and parcel of the game. Maybe, the Indian skipper will buy Malan a beer tonight. Excellent moment. The Indian dressing room is on its feet. A moment to cherish. Can be said that England no longer is Kohli's Achilles Heel. This is his 22nd ton in Test cricket.
Way wide outside off, left alone.
Appeal for a catch, not given. Kohli tries to pull a short ball around middle and leg but misses. Bairstow catches and appeals, the umpire is unmoved. Nothing on the replays.
A low full toss outside off, Kohli drives it to deep cover, denies the run. The crowd boos.
Shortish and outside off, played down towards point.
Tossed up ball on middle, kept away safely to mid-wicket.
Yadav has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Drinks break. The last partnership certainly reduced the deficit but still England have a handy lead in their pocket. Umesh Yadav is the last batsman and he will be on strike. Kohli is on 97 at the other end.

OUT! Ishant Sharma is trapped in front. They appeal and the finger goes up. No DRS taken. Strangely. Rashid serves a googly, landing full around off and spinning in sharply. Ishant ain't forward to this, tries blocking from the crease but is beaten. It hits him on the pads, they appeal and the finger is up. Ishant is distraught and straightaway starts to walk to the pavilion. Hang on, the replays show that it's missing leg. Have India missed a trick? Why didn't Kohli stop his partner? This can prove to be a big moment in this Test match. Anyway a valuable partnership for India, well done Ishant for his gutsy effort with the willow.
Knocks a full ball down to long on and picks up a single. Trusting Ishant to play out the leggie.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven again this time straight to the cover fielder.
Flighted full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
In comes Adil Rashid. A slip in place. Deep cover, deep square, long on, long off, deep mid-wicket. All covered, offering a run to Kohli.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. These two have planned this partnership superbly. Kohli certainly has a bigger say in it but one cannot ignore Ishant's contribution.
A touch short and on off, Kohli moves across and works it in the gap at mid-wicket. Takes a single.
Good pace and bounce. On a length outside off, Kohli leaves it. Bairstow collects it over his head.
Works this one wide of mid on. Broad moves across to his right, dives and parries it towards deep mid-wicket. Kohli calls his partner for the second run.
Kohli has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Starts his spell with a good length ball outside off, Kohli takes a stride forward and slices his drive over Anderson at backward point. The third man fielder moves across to his right and puts in a slide to stop the ball. A couple taken, Kohli 7 short of a ton.
Ben Stokes returns.
Full in length around off, Sharma keeps it out safely at mid on. The stand moves to 29, deficit is down to 76.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Very full and around off, a late swing, Ishant inside edges his attempted drive through square leg and collects a couple.
Shortish and on middle, eased towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball on middle and leg, Virat helps it off his pads but finds square leg.

Curran runs in from 'round the wicket and bowls it full on off. Kohli drives it past the bowler and Broad puts in a dive coming in from long on to stop a certain boundary. Parries it towards Root who has come in from mid off and he returns the ball in play. A couple of runs taken. Kohli moves to 90!
Kohli gets what he wants, like always. A single this time as he taps it down to third man.

Ha ha ha! Kohli is all smiles. Bairstow is all smiles. Even Ishant is smiling. Comical really. A length ball around off, Virat taps it down towards point and since it's the penultimate ball, Ishant thinks that he has to be rushing across for a run. Charges in but his captain sends him back as Jennings is quick to the ball. Has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Sharma puts in a big dive to get himself inside the crease. A rare sight to watch the tall man diving around.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's driven down the ground but straight to mid off.
Serves it wide and outside off, Kohli allows it through this time.
Play and a miss! This is a serious delivery. Kohli is on the walk as he tries driving it but is beaten by the away movement. Anderson once again foxing the Indian skipper.

Good length ball around off, Kohli stays back to punch it towards sweeper cover. No run taken. He is 13 short of his century but surely that won't be in his mind. Would be looking to eat out the deficit as much at possible.
Curran goes even fuller outside off, Ishant tries digging it out but misses.
Fullish and in line of the stumps, Ishant dead bats it.
Drops it short and Kohli pulls it to deep square leg for a run. Two balls to see off for Ishant then.
Unplayable! Nipping away sharply from the batsman from around off, Kohli closes the face of his bat as he tries working it on the leg side. Gets beaten completely.
Fullish and outside off, Kohli plays a well-timed off drive but it's not well-placed. Finds mid off. After that he shadow practices to go over the infield.
Shortish and on off, blocked off the front foot.

Not out! The point of contact indeed is just outside off. Ishant survives again. Jimmy with an inswinger beats India's number 10. Ishant sticks inside the crease to defend but is squared up slightly. It whizzes past the outside half of his bat and raps him on the back leg. The Englishmen appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Sharma takes the help of the DRS and gets the decision overturned.
Ishant has been once again adjudged lbw! Takes the DRS. Impact looks outside off...
Before this ball, Anderson got a man placed at sweeper cover and kept a big open space on the leg side. Bowled it full and Kohli played a delightful drive for a single.

Wow, beaten all ends up. Anderson showing his class. Beats one of the best in the business with an outswinger. Kohli is walking forward with his attempted shot but is foxed completely. The keeper has an immediate shy at the striker's end but misses.
Around off on a length, it's pushed softly with an angled bat to point.
An inviting delivery. A pitched up one wide outside off, there to be driven but Kohli decides not to go after it.
Serves a length ball outside off, nipping in, Kohli is on the front foot as he gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Runs denied off the final ball. A good looking flick shot by Ishant, would have loved some runs off it but that's not what the situation demands. The mid on fielder chases it down but Kohli is not going anywhere. This stand is worth 21 runs now, deficit down to 84 runs.
A nice stride forward by Kohli and he drives it towards mid off for a single.
Ishant plays it towards the off side, in front of square. A single on offer and Kohli collects it.
Produces a straight bat and pushes it back past the bowler. Interestingly takes a single off the third ball. Showing confidence in Ishant?

FOUR! Kohli was trying this shot for some time and finally manages to get it through the gap. There is width on offer outside off, Virat plays it late and with soft hands past the right side of the gully fielder. No stopping this one.

FOUR! Those wrists of steel! Curran overpitches in the greed to achieve extra movement. Gets a bit of inswing going but Kohli has the line and movement covered. Takes a stride forward and flicks it past the left side of the mid-wicket fielder for a glorious boundary.

Anderson bowls it full and wide outside off, inviting the drive. Kohli obliges and strokes it through cover-point. It slows down before the rope but Kohli is satisfied with a single. Keeps strike for the next over.
Rises with the bounce this time, Kohli. Gets on top of the delivery and steers it through point for a couple.
Soft hands. Stays back to tap a length ball towards the gully region.
Fullish and on middle, it's pushed down towards mid on off the front foot. A bit mistimed, not from the middle of the bat.

Direct hit and Ishant was a goner! He plays a shortish length ball down towards point and rushes across to the other end. Buttler attacks the ball, has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Would have been curtains for Sharma. Those long legs of Ishant wouldn't have saved him. Survives. More importantly, Kohli is back on strike.

A loose drive attempted by Kohli. It's an inswinger and as a result it takes the inner half of his bat and rolls behind square leg for a single. Probably, the skipper thought there was a couple available. Misjudges. Ishant has five balls to negotiate.
Not what Root would have wanted. Curran bowls it on the hips and Kohli tucks it down to fine leg for a single. Will retain strike.
Powerful whip from Kohli but he just can't get it past the fielder. Brings his strong wrists into play and hits it to mid-wicket, where Jennings dives low to his left and stops it.
Fraction straight in line, worked away on the leg side.

Banged in short but Kohli is well in control of this pull shot. Keeps it along the ground through square leg. Anderson moves swiftly to his right, slides but can't stop it cleanly. Allows the batsmen to take two.
Fuller in length going across, around off, driven just wide of point. Stokes there dives to his right to make a half-stop but the batsmen still take one. A single results.

Short ball on middle and leg, Kohli top edges the pull over backward square leg. His bottom hand came off that shot, but he still managed to get it away. Ran the first one hard, wanted the second but Ishant wasn't as quick as him.

Safe! Definite inside edge there. Otherwise Ishant would have been a goner. An inswinger not read by Sharma who fails to put bat on ball and is thudded on the pads. Looks dead and the umpire raises his finger as well. Ishant is quick to take the DRS, in fact, his skipper was also ready to advice him the same. The replays roll in and as mentioned above the Snicko shows a spike.
Ishant Sharma has been given out lbw. He immediately takes the DRS. Inside edge?
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Continues to be short outside off, Sharma stands tall to play it down towards the fourth slip fielder. That fielder is under the helmet and is standing a few steps ahead of the original position.
Shortish again, this time Ishant pokes at it and misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, left alone.

OUT! Dawid Malan redeems himself with a catch. Looks at the heavens. He has relief written all over his face. Anderson dishes out a length ball outside off, holding its line, Shami gets forward attempting a drive, not too sure whether through the line or across the line, anyway that would not matter as the ball has found the edge of the bat. It flies behind and Malan at second slip stretches his hands to his left to claim the catch. India's trail is still over 100 and they have two wickets left. Ishant is in next.

Sam arrows in another very full ball in line of the stumps, Kohli gets it away off the thick inside edge towards mid-wicket. Shami is outside the crease and hence the fielder immediately releases the ball at his end. Direct hit would have been interesting.
Curran mixes his length and goes very full outside off. Kohli mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Curran continues to bowl it short and Virat once again tries running it down. Finds the gully fielder again.
Shortish and outside off, played down in front of gully.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Kohli plays a delightful pull off his back foot to deep mid-wicket. Turns down the single.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli defends it off his front leg to mid off.
Risky single to retain strike. The Indian skipper plays it gently towards covers and sets off for a brisk single. The fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end.

Excitement behind the stumps but nothing doing. A touch short in length around off, shaping back in, Kohli walks forward to play at it but misses to get hit on the back thigh. It flies behind and the gully fielder dives forward to attempt for the catch. There was no wood though.
Another delivery in the zone outside off, Virat lets it be.
Keeping its line outside off, Kohli has nothing to do with it.
Length ball angling in from around off, Kohli is on the front foot in defense.
In the right channel, Kohli chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Very full this time, Curran eyeing that yorker area, Shami keeps it out safely.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Turns it off his pads on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Another delivery around middle and leg, the pace is a gentle one and not enough movement. Kohli flicks it in front of square leg and this time beats the fielder in the deep.

Direct hit would have consumed Shami! Kohli works this delivery off his pads to deep mid-wicket and scampers back for the second run. The throw from the deep is flat but it misses the stumps at the bowler's end. The replays show that Shami was a goner. Sam should have come up to the stumps there.
Bouncer outside off, Kohli for a moment looks to play the pull but then bails out. Called a wide for height.
Fullish and outside off, Virat plays it with soft hands to point and steals a single.
Shout for an lbw! Not entertained again. Kohli fails to work around an inswinger. Not picking those. Luckily he is hit outside the line and hence the umpire remains unmoved to the appeal.
Off the mark first ball. Drives a full ball wide of the cover fielder and takes a single.
Mohammed Shami is the new batsman.

OUT! The King of Swing has finally opened his account. And he does so with a beautiful inswinger. Dishes it out around off, Ashwin plays the original line but the inward movement means that he ends up playing inside the line. Misses the ball completely and it goes on to rattle the stumps. Beautiful bowling. Ashwin departs without contributing much. India trail by 117 runs.
Beaten this time. This one holds its line outside off, Ashwin is caught pushing and missing inside the line.

NOT OUT! England have lost both their reviews now. Anderson bowls an in-curler, landing around off and angling down. Kohli tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal for an lbw and then Root goes for the DRS after consulting his bowler and keeper. The replays roll in and they show it to be missing the leg stump.

Huge shout for an lbw! Has Anderson got his first wicket of the match? No, the umpire shakes his head. Root comes up to his bowler, has a little chat and then consults his keeper. Gets convinced and goes for the DRS. Looks to be missing leg to the naked eye. Let's see...
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, Ashwin covers his stumps and allows it through to the keeper.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
An inswinger bowled by Curran, on the fuller length around off and Ravichandran drives it down to mid off.
Movement this time. From around middle and shaping away, Ashwin tries playing it straight but it takes the shoulder of the bat and rolls towards point.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ashwin pushes it with gentle hands to covers.

FOUR! Very much intentional from Ashwin. This is how he bats. Always looks to score off loose deliveries. Curran has offered width wide outside off, shorter in length, Ashwin lifts it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
FOUR! Soft outside edge this time. Kohli plays at a length ball away from his body with a loose bottom hand. It takes the outer half of the bat and screams past the slip cordon for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery on off, Kohli picks the length and decides to defend it from the back foot.
And again. Not going hard at the ball. Just allowing it to come to him and dead batting it.
A length ball on off, Kohli once again is solid in his front foot defense. Offering the full face of the bat and blocking back.
This time Anderson gets full with his length, angling in, Virat shuffles across to clip it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Starts with a gentle length delivery in the channel outside off, no visible movement, Kohli has an easy leave.

Back for the last session. 37 overs minimum left today. Expect plenty of action. India trail by 127 runs with 4 wickets left. As mentioned earlier, the current pair holds the key for them. England to begin with James Anderson, who has been quite unlucky today. Two slips in place. Here we go again...
...DAY 2, THIRD SESSION...

You'd have to spare a thought for Virat Kohli. He's running out of partners and Ashwin seems to be his last genuine one now. The skipper has been given a couple of lives, but such is the case in England, with the ball moving so much. Just have to look ahead and forget about it quickly. He's gone on to score a fifty and is India's primary hope. England for the most part have been all over India, so this Kohli-Ashwin pair has to last the remainder of the day, at the very least. The hosts, well, just need to break this partnership. They enter the tail then and can try to wrap the Indians up quickly. Plenty to look forward to in the final session.

A highly gripping session has come to a close. If this isn't going to keep you hooked, I'm not sure what will. And I feel sorry for those of you who aren't tuning in to this. India were going along well with Kohli and Rahane motoring along. But, Ben Stokes upped his game and broke that stand. Went on to dismiss Karthik quickly, ruining his recent comeback to Test cricket. Kohli continued on with Pandya, a good stand was building, but Curran came to the party again and got rid of the latter with a beaut of a yorker.
Full in length and outside off, Ashwin drives it through the covers. A couple taken and that's TEA ON DAY 2!
FOUR! A risky stroke but Ashwin has executed that well. Inswinging yorker on off, Ashwin opens the face of the bat and squeezes it out past gully for a boundary.
Keeps it full, on off, guarded out off the inside half of the bat.
Fuller in length, outside off, Ashwin presents a defensive bat in response.
Drives this full ball to mid off with the full face of the bat.
Full delivery curling back in, it's flicked neatly through the mid-wicket area for one.
Outside off, Ashwin leaves it to end an eventful over from Ben Stokes.
Length ball angling in on off, Ashwin keeps it out.

Dropped! Test cricket is an entertaining mistress, isn't it? On the previous ball Kohli got to a fifty calmly, now, he's dropped. Anything can happen in this game. Full outside off, Kohli plays at it and edges it. The ball flies towards Malan at second slip, who dives to his right, gets his hand to it but can't hold on. Single taken.

FOUR! Fifty for Virat Kohli! Thoroughly deserved. Captain leading from the front. He's the only batsman who's look assured out there today for the Indians. He opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a boundary.
Brings out the bumper out of nowhere, Kohli ducks.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the next batsman in.

OUT! A toe-crusher from Curran. Literally. What a delivery. Wow. I asked early if he's the one to do it. Well, he is. Producing a repeat performance from the morning. Fires in an inswinging yorker on middle, it comes in and strikes Pandya on the toes. Big appeal and the finger goes up. Hardik reviews it, a desperate attempt for sure, because this looks plumb from everywhere. And replays show just that. A solid partnership of 48 comes to an end. Kohli will run out of partners soon like this.
Review time. Although I'm not sure why. Hardik Pandya looks like a dead duck. He's going to be gone surely...

Direct hit from Root but Kohli is well in. Missed his chance to get back at him. Kohli taps to covers and sets off. Takes the English skipper on there and makes it in with ease, despite the direct hit at the bowler's end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A little fuller, just outside off, dabbed with an open face to point.
Works this across the line, through mid-wicket, and finally brings Kohli on strike.
Full and angling across, Hardik goes for the drive with hard hands and ends up placing it to covers.
A misfield from Broad and India are allowed some extra runs. Hardik wrists it towards him at wide mid on. He lets it go through him and conceded three. Pandya will keep strike.
Three leaves in a row. Stokes keeps hurling it outside off, Pandya keeps leaving it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Harmless delivery outside off, left alone.
Full around off, Hardik looks to go at this with hard hands and ends up mistiming the drive to mid on.
Back of a length close to off, blocked.
Ben Stokes is back on.

Mix-up here! But, much to India's delight, no damage done. Pandya works this down to fine leg and takes one. He takes off for the second unnecessarily when Kohli isn't even looking at him. Is sent back, just in time, as the throw is a bit weak. Bairstow collects and turns to throw, but it's too late by then.
Positions himself right behind the line and keeps it out with a straight blade.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
In the same region again. No run taken.
Coming in on middle and off, on a bit of a fuller length, blocked tightly towards mid on.
Length delivery on off stump, blocked out with the full face of the bat.
Behind a good length, on off, strikes Kohli high on the thigh pad as he misses his block.
FOUR! Poor line from Broad and he's paid the price. On the pads, Kohli moves inside the line and flicks it fine down the leg side past Buttler, and easily sends it across the boundary line.
Brings those wrists into play as he opens the face and taps it away to the man at cover-point.
Angling in on middle and off, worked softly on the leg side.

FOUR! As sweet as butter. Full outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and drives it square through point for a boundary. With that, surprisingly, this is Kohli highest score in England in Tests. A bit unbelievable, isn't it?
Outside off on a good length, left alone by the batsman.

FOUR! In the air but that's just short. Not far away at all. Fuller on off, Pandya wrists this towards mid on albeit aerially. Broad there dives to his right, but the ball just falls in front of him and goes through him to the fence.
Pushes this towards mid off, take the fielder there on and wins too as he completes the single with great ease.
Not even remotely close to the off pole, so Virat Kohli lets it be.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and guards it out safely.
On off, pushed back defensively in the bowler's direction.
Angles across a length delivery, outside off, Kohli presses forward to defend but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Sam Curran to bowl for the first time in this session. Kohli and Pandya are doing a good job of hanging in there, maybe the left-armer can provide the breakthrough like he did in the morning.
Fuller on off, driven with the full face of the bat to mid on.
Just outside off, a length ball, blocked with a perfectly straight bat.
Staying disciplined. This is good stuff from Hardik. It's well outside off so he doesn't bother to play a shot at it.
Goes full this time, just outside off, defended with a big lunge forward towards covers.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, takes a big stride forward, covers the line and shoulders arms.
Shortish in length on middle and off, blocked right under his nose.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Sharp bumper from Stokes. Angles it in on middle and leg, takes the batsman by surprise. Hardik ducks late, but just manages to evade it.
Outside off, Hardik has a poke at it but fails to make connection.
Shoots off the surface as Stokes bowls it outside off. Pandya makes a simple leave.
Stays back, watches the ball and keeps it out.
Nicely done. Hardik uses the angle and works it through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket region. A brace is collected.
FOUR! Good end to the over. Sprays it on the pads, all Kohli needs to do is tickle it on its way and he does that. Gets it across the fine leg fence and that's a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Watches the ball go past him as it's pitched well outside off.
FOUR! Could watch that all day and all night long! Beautiful timing from Virat Kohli. Fuller outside off, he drives this on the up and pierces the gap through the covers for a boundary.
A beaut! Broad brought the first one in, makes this one go the other way. Late movement, a slightest of it and it just beats the edge.
Angling in, marginally ahead of a good length, blocked off the front foot.
Angles in at first and then it straightens up. Hardik is squared up a bit as he looks to defend. Gets beaten comprehensively as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Fuller from the bowler, met with a straight blade in defense.
Hardik lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Beaten! Barely. This is a great delivery. Stokes has been right on the money since he's come on to bowl. Back of a length just around off, holds its line and beats the outside edge of Hardik Pandya's bat.
So coolly done. Looks in complete control now. Just places this half-pull through square leg and changes ends.
Angles it in from a little wide of the crease, Virat defends it on the off side with an open face.
A hint of outward movement for Broad as he pitches it outside off. Pandya tries to block by reaching out to it but is beaten.
On the fifth stump line, Hardik opens the face and dabs it down in front of gully.
Full and wide outside off, Hardik makes an easy leave.
Bit of a risky leave for Hardik. A length ball which cuts back in from outside off, just about whiskers past the off stick.
Works this just wide of mid on and gets to the other end.
Some extra bounce for the big man Broad. Serves it on a length on off, Kohli defends it out off the top half of the bat.
Full and straight from Stokes, Hardik drives it straight back firmly. The bowler gets low and stops it in his followthrough.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Hurls it well outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Gets inside the line and tucks this short of a length delivery down to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside the line of off stump, it isn't bothered with by the batsman.
Fuller and angling in on off stump, Kohli comes forward and works it off the inner half to square leg. Runs the first one hard and manages to come back for the second.

Drinks break! A wonderful hour of play for England. Got the ball to move and have half the Indian side back in the hut. India trail by 174 runs. All hopes on Kohli, like always. Pandya needs to keep his head strong as well. Another riveting hour coming up...
Hardik shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Nice shot and well fielded. Full and in line of the stumps, Pandya drives it along the turf back towards the bowler. Broad gets low and makes the stop.
HP shoulders arms to let that one through.
Play and miss from Pandya. Length ball around off, just does enough to beat the outside edge of Pandya.
Drives this past the mid off fielder to change ends.
Length around off, Kohli blocks it with the bottom of his bat as the ball dies before the stumps.

Full and around off, Kohli drives it to mid off and quickly sets off for the run. Stokes there, collects and has a shy but cannot hit the target. 1000 Test runs for the Indian skipper against England!
Pitches this one up in line of the stumps, Kohli drives it back to the bowler
Flicks this off his pads through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Great! Similar shot and through the same region. Waits for the ball to come to him and cuts it through gully for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Deliberately done! Nice from Pandya. Sees the ball outside off, plays the ball away from his body though but hits it in the gap through gully from a boundary.
Back of a length on that fifth stump line, Hardik stays in the crease and pulls out from the shot. Good ball.
Gets behind the ball and plays the ball back to the bowler.
Leans ahead and cuts it to point.
Tries working this to the on side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full and around off, no timing on that as Kohli drives it to mid off.
Length outside off, easy leave for Kohli. This partnership is very important for India if they want to get close to England's total.
Full and on middle, played to mid on.
Outside off, cut past the fielder at point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bangs this one short, Kohli ducks under it.
Kohli shoulders his arms to this.
Length around off, Kohli cannot get bat to ball.

DROPPED! What's happening? That's two catches dropped in two balls. This time Cook the culprit. Stokes bowls this a tad full around off, Pandya looks to block it but gets a thick edge to Cook at first slip. The ball wobbles towards the end as it reaches him, and the Chef cannot hold onto it. They cross as the ball goes past the fielder.

Dropped! Oh dear! Malan has dropped Kohli. How costly will that prove? On a good length around off, Kohli goes fishing and gets a fat edge to it. It flies to Malan at second slip who gets low but puts it down.
Virat lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On a good length in line of the stumps, Kohli bunts it down.
Outside off, Kohli does not bother playing at it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, left alone.

Appeal for an lbw and it is given! But Pandya takes the review and survives. A good one in the end. A fuller ball on middle and leg. It swings back in and catches the front leg of Pandya. England appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Pandya has a chat with his skipper and takes it up. Replays shows us that the ball would have gone on to miss the leg stump. Pandya and India survive a scare.
Defended off the back foot by Pandya.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Another edge! Length ball around off, Pandya pokes at it and gets a soft edge to the slip cordon.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Karthik fails to make this opportunity count. Leaves a big gap between bat and pad, so big that even a zephyr could fit in it and it brings his downfall. Full ball around off, it jags back in through the gate and goes on to uproot the middle stump. Karthik looks back to see what he has done. That's the 100th wicket for Ben Stokes in Test cricket. Meanwhile, Hardik Pandya walks out to replace him.
Short and wide outside off, DK sways away from it.
Cut in half! Anderson so far edging Kohli. Only slightly though. Brings this one back in as Kohli looks to force it on the off side. Is cut in half as the ball goes past the inside edge.
Stays inside his crease and dabs it well short of gully.

What a dangerous leave! That was literally centimeters away from the off bail. Goodness me! Length ball around off, comes back in as Kohli shoulders arms to it. Don't think he expected it to come back in. That was close.

The Indians are getting a bit jittery here. It's showing. Kohli taps this towards covers and sets off. Karthik immediately sends him back and rightly too. Root gets to the ball quickly and could have inflicted a run out. The visitors losing their captain is the last thing they need right now.
Opens the face of the bat and dabs it to point.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, the batsman has nothing to do with it.
Covers his stumps, gets behind the ball and presents a straight bat.
Full around off, comes back in. Karthik gets low and leaves it alone.

OUT! He's gone! Just when we were praising Rahane he's out of here. On a good length outside off, the ball bounces a little more than usual. Rahane is not fully into his late cut and hangs his bat outside. He gets a thick edge to it and the ball flies to Jennings at third slip. He collects the ball at chest height and joins in on the celebration. The umpires make Rahane wait as they want to check the no ball but Stokes does well not to overstep. They trail still by 187. What's next for India? Dinesh Karthik is the new man in.

FOUR! Well played! That's the thing about Rahane. He plays the ball very late outside Asia and that's why he is such a success. Once again on this occasion waits for the ball and cuts it past the gully fielder towards third man for a boundary. That also brings up the 100 for the visitors.
On a good length around off, Rahane plays it with soft hands towards point.
Full and wide outside off, Rahane watches it go through to Jonny.
Further away outside off, left alone to end the over.
Goes a little fuller, close to off, Kohli defends it off the inside half onto his pads.
Back of a length outside off, the Indian captain is sure as he lets it go past him.
Back of a length, this one is coming in, Kohli is a tad late in bringing his bat down as the ball skids off the surface. Just about gets the job done.
Just ahead of a length, close to off, Virat is solid in defense.
Angling in first, then seaming away off the deck. Kohli is watchful as he defends it down in front of point.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR LEG BYES! Short ball down the leg side, Rahane looks to leave it alone but it hits his elbow guard and goes past Bairstow to the fine leg fence. The umpire signals leg byes and Stokes is not pleased. He thinks that Rahane was not offering a shot there and that should have not been given.
Covers his stumps and blocks it out.
Defended off the front foot by Rahane presenting the full face of the bat.
Another one! Full and around off, Rahane is invited for the drive but cannot put bat to ball.
Beauty! On a good length around off, Rahane goes for the drive but connects with thin air.
Brilliant over from Jimmy. Got the edge of Kohli twice and almost got the back of him. Bowls this one full on middle, Kohli sees it off.

Edged... and once again short of the fielder. Boy! Anderson is doing everything right. What has Kohli had for lunch? Serves this on a good length outside off, Kohli hangs his bat out and gets a soft edge which falls just short of Jennings at third slip. Kohli survives. England have missed a trick here.
Full this time on middle and leg, Kohli drives it back to the bowler.
Similar line, Anderson making Kohli think, but the latter leaves it alone.
Edged but just short. The battle is living up to it. On a good length on that fourth stump line. Kohli pokes at it but plays it with soft hands. The ball falls just short of the second slip fielder.
Good length ball on that fourth stump line, Kohli is not forced to play at it.

Long appeal but nothing from the umpire. Must be an inside edge. Length ball on middle, it comes back in and catches Rahane on his front leg. Stokes appeals but the umpire stays put. They think about the review for a long time but decide against it. Now then! Replays show us that the ball would have gone to hit the leg stump. Oh dear!
Full and around off, moves away from Rahane who leaves it alone.
Covers his stumps and bunts this down.
Rahane plays it with an angled bat and guides it to short third man.
Good leave! Better from Stokes. Gets it closer to Rahane. Jinx thinks of playing at it but withdraws at the last moment.
Too wide and full, Rahane stays back and is not bothered to play at it.
On a good length outside off, Virat lets it be.
Length outside off, Kohli plays it with soft hands to the third slip fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by AR. They pick up a single.
Too wide outside off, Rahane stays back and cuts it past point. They run the first one hard and come back for the second.
Pitches it up further outside off, Rahane is happy to leave it alone.
Full and outside off, easy leave for Rahane.
James Anderson to bowl from the other end.
Peach! Beauty from Stokes! Lands this on a good length around that off stump, forces Kohli to play at it and almost gets his outside edge.
Bouncer outside off, Kohli does well to leave it alone.
Length outside off, Kohli gets closer to the ball and shoulders his arms.
FOUR! Class! There is something about Kohli's cover drive. Reaches out to the pitch of the ball and creams this through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, easy leave for Virat.
FOUR! First one of the session! Kohli will now play more openly rather than just hitting the loose balls. Gets forward to this full pitched ball and cuts it to the third man region for a boundary.
Starts with a no ball. Back of a length outside off, Kohli taps it towards point.

We are back for the afternoon session. Kohli and Rahane have some repairing work to do. England will know that they need just one wicket to expose up the inexperienced lower middle order. Ben Stokes is given the ball to bowl the first over post lunch. Three slips in for him.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

England's morning! Hands down. No debate about it whatsoever and it's all thanks to their young warrior Sam Curran. England just lasted 10 balls earlier in the day as they got bowled out for 287. India were in a position of power as both Dhawan and Vijay got off to a solid start. Everything changed though when Curran dismissed Vijay and Rahul in a single over, then came back in his next to get rid of Dhawan. With the top order in tatters and India 3 down, Kohli and Rahane have plenty of work to do. The afternoon session is going to be a good one. So join in at 1340 local (1240 GMT) for all the action.
Loopy and fuller, the googly, Rahane picks it up and flicks it through square leg for a couple. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Low full toss from the leggie, played back to the bowler.
Rashid bowls this slower through the air and lands it full on off, the batsman is solid in defense.
Another full toss, driven through the covers again. Two more to the total.
Tossed up on middle and off, Rahane comes forward and blocks it out.
High full toss around off, Kohli hits it through the covers for a single.
This will be the last over before lunch and Adil Rashid will have a last crack at this pair.
Curran switches to around the wicket and angles this full delivery in from around off, Rahane sweetly drives this through mid off and comes back for the second.
Too straight from Curran, darts it on the pads. Kohli wrists this comfortably through to deep square leg and changes ends.
FOUR! This is the one that goes away. Kohli picks it up quickly, positions himself well and opens the face to dab it past the slip cordon. Easy boundary for him.
Fraction straight in line, gives Rahane the chance to move inside the line and tuck it behind square leg for one.
Shortish outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
It's arrowed across full, outside off, Rahane plants his front foot forward and defends it to covers.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Kohli remains patient as he doesn't meddle with it.
Well outside off, extra bounce again for Jimmy. Kohli leaves it alone.
On the fifth stump channel, left alone.
Fuller again, around off, pushed away with hard hands towards gully.
Some extra bounce on offer for Anderson. He pitches it just ahead of a length on off, it kicks off the deck and catches the handle of Kohli's bat. He did well to get his bottom hand off that.
Fullish in length attacking the stumps, kept out solidly off the front foot.
Too wide of off stump, easy leave for the batsman to make.
Fuller outside off, not much movement on this occasion, a defensive push from Rahane back down to mid off.
Opens the bat face late and taps this length ball down in front of point.
Full ball aiming the base of off stump, driven off the outer half square on the off side. One run to the total.
Brings out the short one as he hits the deck hard, it's going across but Virat is watchful as he lets it be.
Darts a length ball around off, it cuts back in as Rahane comes forward to push it away towards the covers. Both batsmen sense the run and complete it with ease.
Good leave. Very good leave. Closer to off, shaping away from a length, Kohli covers the line and shoulders arms.
Wide outside off, another leave from the Indian skipper.
Kohli walks a step across, gets behind the line and drives it to mid on.
Good length delivery outside the line of off stump, left alone.
Speared full well outside off, Kohli gets low to drill it through the off side but gets it off the bottom half back down the track. Needs to be more careful here. These shots aren't needed.

Did that carry? Not sure, that's very tight. India in the line of fire now. Anderson bowls this full and swings it away, Kohli drives away from his body and gets a thick edge. It flies low towards gully, where Buttler dives to his left but can't get his fingers underneath it. Cook chases after it as it's rolling down to third man and does well to keep it in. Jennings throws it back in. Two runs taken.
Coming back in on middle and leg, Rahane blocks it out down the track. This brings us to the end of another successful over from Sam Curran. Brilliant stuff from him.
Ajinkya Rahane is next in. India are in trouble here and he will need to tough it out now with his skipper.

OUT! And Sam Curran strikes again. His third of the morning and he's ripped through the Indian top order. Absolutely stunning bowling from the left-armer. Again, good pace on this as he pitches it around off, makes it go away and this time he draws the edge as Dhawan goes for the drive. Straight into the hands of Dawid Malan at second slip who takes a good catch.
And the crowd cheers! Right so too, young Sam is bowling with a lot of intent here. Length delivery on off, seaming away late. Dhawan is beaten all ends up.
A fourth slip coming in place. Root giving his bowler every chance here.

Edged and FOUR! Full ball, swinging away on off, Dhawan closes the face early and gets a big edge. It flies well past the third slip fielder and races to the third man fence. Curran is bowling with some serious pace.
Better. Keeps it close to off this time, shapes it away late. Dhawan stands firm and blocks it down in front of point.
Way, way outside off, Dhawan leaves it alone.
Short of a length on off, tapped down in front of gully to end a testing over from Jimmy Anderson.

Ooohh! Now that will make him think a bit. Kohli had the line covered, but he thought this was going to go away like the others. But it came back in and went through to the keeper. Not too close, but not too far away either from the off stick.
Good leave. Outside off, rising off the surface, Virat Kohli has nothing to do with that one.
Angling in at first and then straightening up a shade, Kohli looks to block but gets it off the outer half to gully.
Good length delivery shaping away from around off, Kohli covers the line and shoulders his arms to it.
Now here it is! The most-talked about contest in this Test. Anderson vs Kohli. Three slips and a gully placed for the feisty Indian skipper. Here we go...
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan taps it down in front of covers and takes one.
Virat Kohli walks out to bat next amidst loud jeers from the crowd.

OUT! Second of the over from Sam Curran. A poor shot really from KL Rahul. It's just your second ball, got to avoid it. Full and fired outside off, angling across, Rahul goes for the expansive drive through the covers but gets a big inside edge. Drags it back onto his stumps and they're shattered. Big turnaround for England after a fantastic start by India.
FOUR! Off the mark in a streaky manner! Sam with a length ball on off, Rahul hangs his bat out in defense and gets a thick edge which runs down to third man. Boundary results.
KL Rahul walks in at no.3.

OUT! GONE! Sam Curran draws first blood for England. Good decision from Joe Root on this occasion. It's on a length on middle and leg, straightens up after landing and then raps Vijay on the front pad who misses his defense. Big shout, but the umpire doesn't bother with it. After some deliberation, Root decides to review it and takes it upstairs. Replays come in and they show that Vijay is caught flush in front of stumps. Red on all three boxes and he's out of here.
Another review from England. It's for another lbw decision, against Murali Vijay. This one looks close. Let's see now...
Fires it full on this occasion, Vijay jams it out in front of covers.
Serves it on a length, in line of the stumps, a defensive bat is offered in response.
The umpires are checking the shape of the ball. Put it through the 8-shape gauge and feel everything is fine. We're good to continue.
Good length delivery on middle and off, with a hint of movement away off the seam, Vijay is perfectly behind the line as he blocks it out.
Driven off the inner half towards mid on and that will be the end of the over.
There was some noise but no bat involved. Angling down, Dhawan misses the tickle as the ball brushes his thigh pad. Bairstow does well to dive to his right and stop it.
Anderson angles in a full delivery on middle and off, Dhawan closes the face a bit too early to flick it away but gets it safely back down the track towards the bowler.
Keeps it fuller, on the fifth stump channel, the left-hander remains patient and lets it through.
Makes sweet connection once again but it's straight to the fielder. Dhawan drives it crisply straight to the man at extra cover.
Outside off on a good length, Dhawan covers the line well and shoulders arms to it.
Short of a good length on off stump, Murali Vijay stands tall and defends it right under his nose.
Better. Brings it in closer around off, blocked out with a straight bat.
Once more, too far outside off, Vijay has nothing to do with it. Curran needs to make him play more.
Hurls it too far outside off this time, no shot offered by the batsman.
So close! Outside off on a good length, holds its line just enough, Vijay has a tame poke at it and gets beaten.

Too full and too straight on the pads, whipped away by Shikhar to deep backward square leg. One run taken and the 50 is up for India. It's their first opening fifty stand after 16 innings against England in England.
Good leave from Murali Vijay. Kept his eyes on the ball throughout as it was banged short. Arched back and dropped his wrists to let it through.
Straighter one, just around off, skidding off the deck a bit, Vijay comes forward and blocks it off the inner half on the leg side.
Straightening up on leg, Vijay easily picks it off his pads and flicks it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Angling back in on middle and leg, easy enough for Shikhar Dhawan to clip this down to fine leg. Single taken.
Fuller again, close to off, tapped away towards covers.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls this on a fullish length around off, Dhawan is half-forward as he pushes this back in the bowler's direction.

Drinks break! This is a good start from the visiting team. They have never got a 50-run opening stand in their last 16 innings against England, in England. They look good to get it today. Who will step up for the hosts and provide the breakthrough?
FOUR! Beauty! Leans ahead and creases this in the gap through the cover region. Root runs behind it but cannot stop the ball from reaching the fence. Boundary. Solid start from the visitors.
Well left. Fuller ball outside off, it shapes away from Vijay. He thinks of playing at it but leaves it alone.
Yorker on off, Vijay digs it out on time.
MV has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, gets it off the bottom of the bat to the on side.
Starts by bowling one outside off, Vijay is not enticed to play at it.
Sam Curran is called to bowl.
FOUR LEG BYES! Another wrong line down the leg side, Dhawan looks to help it on its way. It takes the thigh pad and runs away to the fine leg region.
On a good length around that fifth stump line. Dhawan watches it go past to the keeper.
Outside off, too far to make Dhawan play at it.
SD shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Off line and gets punished. Dhawan will put that away all day long. Serves this on the leg side, Dhawan keeps his head strong and flicks it away through square leg for a boundary.
Shot! But straight to the fielder. Anderson and Broad are inviting the drives and hopefully get something off it. Pitches this up around off, Dhawan drives it to covers.
FOUR! Sweet! Right off the middle. Pitched up ball outside off, Vijay gets behind the ball and drives it through cover-point for a boundary. Nobody bothers chasing that one.
Outside off, Vijay points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Angles this on the legs of Vijay who hops a tad and flicks it to deep backward square leg for a brace. Good start from India.
Peach! That's it, Broad. That's where you need to bowl. On a good length around off, it keeps low and goes under the bat of Vijay.
Once again strays on the pads, Vijay clips it to mid-wicket.
Nicely tucked away. Not the best of lines to be bowled with the new ball. Lands this down the leg side. Dhawan tucks it away to deep square leg for one.
Covers the stumps and plays this towards the leg side.
Vijay has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls this one on a good length on middle and leg, the ball takes a little extra bounce, before taking the inside edge onto the pads of Vijay.
Back of a length ball on the pads, Dhawan tucks it around the corner for a single.
Full and around off, driven to mid on.
Leg bye. Looks to tuck this back of a length ball to the on side but gets it off his thigh pad. They complete the run as the ball rolls towards square leg.
Length on middle and leg, played towards the bowler.
On that fifth stump channel, Dhawan lets it be.
FOUR! Shot! A very good shot from Dhawan, the classic cover drive. Leans ahead to this overpitched ball outside off and creams it through covers. The ball races away to the fence.
Third no ball in three overs from Broad. Length ball on middle, Dhawan tucks it to the on side.
Beaten! Ripper from Broad. Lands it on off and makes it go away, Dhawan hangs his bat close to his body and almost nicks it behind. Lucky for him the ball whiskered past the edge.
Played it with soft hands, that was the key. Vijay got it off the outer half towards gully.
Good length delivery shooting off the surface a bit, Vijay remains rock solid in defense.
Just ahead of a length, around off, Vijay stands his ground and keeps it out.
Shot. Good timing from Shikhar. He cleanly drives this full delivery outside off through mid off. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs.

Oooohhh! Almost. Close call for Dhawan. Fuller in length and tailing back in, Dhawan plays at it and gets an inside edge back onto his pads. It rolls behind, it's going to miss the leg stump but the southpaw doesn't take any chances and puts it away with his bat.
Fuller length delivery on middle and off, Dhawan drives it to mid-wicket.
On a good length around off, the ball jags back in but Vijay watches it go to the keeper.
MV chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Vijay picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper by swaying away.
Pushed to the cover region by Dhawan. They pick up a single.
No ball. Another one from Broad. Dhawan hits this to the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Another loud appeal but once again the umpire stays put. Broad comes in from over the wicket and lands it around leg. Dhawan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal but nothing from the umpire. The English players have a chat but opt against the use of DRS. Good they didn't take it up as the replays show us that it pitched outside leg.
First the inside edge, now the outside edge. Vijay leans ahead to play the drive but cannot make contact.

NOT OUT! Vijay survives. There was no inside edge but the ball was going down leg. Anderson fires this one full and on the pads. Vijay tries to flick this but gets hit on the pads. On the first look, it seemed like an inside edge. The English players appeal but the umpire says no. Anderson has a talk with Root and they take it upstairs. Replays roll in and show us no inside edge, as the bat hit the pad, but the ball would have gone on to miss the leg stump. England lose their review.
An LBW review has been taken up! Looks to be an inside edge.
Tries flicking the ball down the leg side but it goes off the pads towards the on side. They take the leg bye.
The ball is too wide on the off side for SD to make any contact.
Good ball from Anderson! Lands this around off and it shapes away from Dhawan. He hangs his bat out but the ball goes past him.
Dhawan shoulders arms to let that one through.
Jaffa! That's the perfect length for these batsmen. Served outside off, Vijay goes fishing and almost gets an outside edge.

FOUR! Classic! First of the Indian innings. Overpitched ball on middle and leg, Vijay stands tall and just punches this down the ground. The mid on fielder hares to stop the ball but only comes second best.
No ball for overstepping. Broad oversteps and lands this on the leg stump line, Dhawan flicks it towards fine leg for one.
Pitches it up outside off, Dhawan gets it off the inner half towards mid off.
Gets behind the ball and milks this through mid-wicket for a single.
Very full again in line of the stumps, Vijay blocks it out well.

Had he hit, Vijay would have had to keep walking. Broad pitches it up on that fourth stump line. Dhawan gets an inside edge while trying to play a drive. It rolls to the off side off his pads, Stokes hares from point, picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end. Vijay will feel lucky he didn't score a direct hit.
Stuart Broad will bowl from the other end. Three slips in place along with a gully.
Full and on the legs, hit to mid on to end the over.
Vijay has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Misses his line and serves it on the pads of Dhawan who flicks it away through mid-wicket. Broad mops it up but India get three runs.
Full and wide outside off, Dhawan shoulders his arms to it. All eyes will be on Shikhar. He needs to come good.
First run of the Indian innings! The crowd acknowledges it. Vijay taps this with soft hands towards point and gets to the other end. Good running.
Starts from over the wicket and pitches it up in search for swing. Vijay gets behind the ball and blocks it.
